details:
# Issue:

Behavior of the group ownership indicator of a group instance where the group is invalid is inconsistent. I joined a friend in an group public instance where it seems that the group that created the instance was removed or otherwise invalid and noticed that the indicator for the group owning the instance would copy the last group viewed and would be unclickable.

# Reproduction Steps:

1. Enter a group instance of a group that no longer exists

2. Open the instance window and take note of what group the window things is the owner of the instance.

3. Attempt to click the group in the instance window. Nothing should happen

4. Click on another group instance in the instance window

5. Click back onto the instance you are in

6. Observe that the instance window now says that the group you just looked at is the owner of the instance you are in.

# Expected Behavior:

Not sure on the expected behavior here as this is clearly an edge case that does not happen frequently. I guess I expect the group listed to show an error/invalid group as I think showing the last group looked at could potentially cause confusion.

# Attachments Description:

Attached is a video showcasing the bug after discovery. I do not know what the original group that was running the instance was, only that it likely no longer exists.
title: Group Indicator for Group Instance where the Group has been removed copies groups from other viewed instances.
